moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The final Bank Holiday of the summer for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking a long weekend for many before autumn truly sets in.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Who's already counting down to the August Bank Holiday weekend? What are your plans for that last taste of summer freedom?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: It's the last Bank Holiday of the summer in England, Wales & Northern Ireland on August 31st! Make it count.
